publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In the study of brain-computer interface (BCI) technology, it is difficult to distinguish and recognize electroencephalogram (EEG) signals induced by motor imagery in different movements of the same joint. In order to improve the recognition rate of upper limb shoulder dichotomous motion imagination by BCI system, 50Hz notch filter and de-baseline drift processing are used to remove power frequency interference, and common average reference (CAR) method is used to preprocess the collected EEG data. Secondly, EEG data collected from four electrode channels, FC5, F3, F4 and FC6, are extracted by common spatial pattern (CSP). Finally, the twin support vector machine (TWSVM) is used to recognize the motion imagination state. The experimental results show that the recognition accuracy of upper limb shoulder motion imagination reaches 85.29%. Compared with other methods, the recognition rate is higher.

Author Keywords: brain computer interface technology, upper shoulder motion imagination, common average reference, common spatial pattern, twin support vector machine

articleTitle: Distribution Network Load Forecasting Based on Improved BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In order to overcome the inherent defects of traditional neural networks, and further improve the short-term power load prediction accuracy of the station, the genetic algorithm is introduced to optimize the classical neural network algorithm, the initial value and threshold of the neural network are recalculated, and the prediction model is established. The predicted results are obtained through simulation training and compared. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm is proved by an example of a city.

Author Keywords: Power system, genetic algorithm, neural network, short-term load forecasting

articleTitle: The Finite Element Analysis of a Dish Tubesheet Structure
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: flexible tubesheets are special non-standard structures which are more and more used in shell-and-tube heat exchangers. In this paper, a dish tubesheet is used in an oxidation reactor. Finite element method is employed to analyze the stress distribution at the dish tubesheet and strength assessment is performed based on design-by-analysis approach. In addition, a flat tubesheet with the same thickness is also numerical simulated and stress analysis is carried out. It is found that compared with the flat tubesheet having the same thickness, the stress at the central area of the dish tubesheet under thermal or pressure loadings is greatly reduced. It means that if under the same loading and assessed by the same strength criteria, the thickness of the dish tubesheet will be much smaller than that of flat tubesheet.

Author Keywords: dish tubesheet, finite element analysis, stress distribution, strength assessment

articleTitle: Scheme Design and Key Technologies of Quality Monitoring for Bearing Ring Groove Grinding
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Bearing is the most important component of mechanical equipment, bearing ring is a basic part of the rolling bearing, its groove is the working surface of rolling bearing, and its accuracy will directly affect the performance and life of bearing. Grinding is the main method to ensure machining quality of ring groove, and grinding process is very important to final quality of bearing products. Therefore, quality monitoring scheme of grinding process based on grinding theory and condition monitoring technology is advanced to guide and implement quality monitoring, and key technologies such as pretreatment method of experimental data, orthogonal test method of state parameter and grinding quality, and quality prediction method based on BP neural network. This study can provides theoretical and technical support for quality and manufacturing level improving of bearing ring groove processing.

Author Keywords: bearing ring, groove grinding, quality monitoring, scheme design, key technologies

articleTitle: Parameter Free Clustering Algorithm Based on Density and Natural Nearest Neighbor
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: The purpose of clustering algorithm is to explore the correlation of a large number of unlabeled data, so as to find valuable information in chaotic data. There are many kinds of clustering algorithms, but most of them need one or more parameters to be selected based on experience, and the selection of parameters will directly affect the accuracy of clustering algorithm, for example, DBSCAN needs domain radius and number of radius points; k-means algorithm needs to know the number of clusters in advance, k-nearest neighbor algorithm needs to be selected. Choose the appropriate number of neighbors, etc. In order to realize parametric clustering, we adopt the concept of natural nearest neighbor, and let data points discover neighbors independently by iteration. To make up for the problem that the selected K value may not be appropriate, in the process of clustering, we proposes a method of similarity between clusters, which is used to modify the misclassified clusters. Finally, the similarity of observation points is proposed. To distinguish boundary points from outliers. By comparing with DBSCAN, BIRCH and K-MEANS, proved that our algorithm can achieve good performance than other algorithms.

Author Keywords: cluster, parameter free,

articleTitle: Application of A-Priori Algorithm in Vibration Fault Diagnosis for Rotary Machinery
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Large rotary machineries are very important in factories. Their running intact or not directly affects the economic efficiency of enterprises. Vibration fault is one of the most common types of faults in rotary machineries, therefore it has always been the core research direction in rotating equipment fault diagnosis. We use the Apriori algorithm to find the correlation between the actual data and fault phenomenon from the massive rotating equipment vibration data, and then create a rule knowledge base composed by failure phenomenon, failure reasons and expert advices. The proposed method was applied to a real case. To examine our extracted rules, it was found that about half of them were included in the existed experts' rules, and about 70% new created rules were confirmed by experts. The experimental result shows effectiveness and feasibility of our proposed method.

Author Keywords: Data mining, Rotary machinery, Fault diagnosis, Association rules

articleTitle: Automatic Generation of Single-Phase SVPWM Embedded Code
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Aiming at the contradiction between the extensive application of DSP and the entry barrier of its programming platform, this paper studies the automatic code generation method based on Matlab model design. This method saves time and manpower in using DSP, and the generated code is highly standardized, simple and easy to read. Based on the single-phase SVPWM technology, this paper introduces the code generation process and the control of the generated code in detail. The TMS320F28335-based single-phase SVPWM algorithm model is built with the Texas Instruments C2000 library and Simulink common library, and the DSP executable file is directly generated by Simulink. Download the DSP chip, observe the relevant pin waveform through the oscilloscope, and the experimental results are completely consistent with the theory, which verifies the fastness, simplicity, correctness of the method

Author Keywords: Single phase inverter, Single-phase SVPWM, DSP Code generation, Code generation control, CCS & Simulink joint development

articleTitle: Research on Data Distribution for VANET Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a vehicular ad hoc network (VANET) data distribution scheme based on artificial intelligence software-defined network (SDN) controller. Our aim is to improve the throughput of VANET by selecting edge cluster head nodes and gateway cluster head nodes based on deep reinforcement learning. In the entire VANET network, SDN determines the edge cluster head through neural episodic control (NEC). The gateway cluster head is determined by Q-learning. Then the gateway cluster head nodes act as the role that download the data from road side units (RSU) and then transmit the data to vehicles which need these data. Numerical results have shown the proposed scheme can provide greater throughput in VANET compared with the existing scheme.

Author Keywords: data distribution, deep reinforcement learning, reinforcement learning, VANET.

articleTitle: The Research of Qualification Detection of Cable Joint Solder Joint Based on DCNN
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In view of the problems of low recognition rate, slow detection speed and poor generalization of existing traditional detection methods, a DCNN-based method for detecting the solder joint qualification of cable joints is proposed. Firstly, the method corrects the tilted image by Discrete Fourier Transformation, Hough Line Detection and Affine Transformation to extract the solder joint area. Secondly, the features of the solder joint area are extracted by establishing a deep convolutional neural network. Finally, the solder joints are classified by the Softmax classifier. Experiments show that the recognition rate of the method reaches 98.6% and the detection speed is 0.078 sec/sheet, which has higher practical application value than other traditional algorithms.

Author Keywords: deep convolutional, neural network, conformity detection, image correction, batch standardization

articleTitle: Research on Demand Response Mechanism Based on Multi-Agent Participation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Demand response business is becoming more and more complicated under the opening of retail side. It involves a large number of capital flow operations in subsidy settlement, penalty for breach of contract and so on. It needs a kind of technical means for effective management and protection. Based on the possible problems of multi-agent participation in demand response business, this paper analyzes the matching point between blockchain technology and demand response business, and finally designs a multi-agent participation demand response mechanism. Finally, the prospect of future research is proposed.

Author Keywords: demand response, blockchain, data sharing

articleTitle: Accelerated Life Test and Life Prediction of an Electromechanical Actuator
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: This paper gives an accelerated test method for electromechanical actuator (EMA) and predicts its life based on Wiener process degradation model. According to the historical fault data and the FMECA analysis, we obtain that the key weak links of the electromechanical actuators are the electromagnetic clutch and the tachogenerator. The electromagnetic clutch accelerated test is designed by increasing the test frequency, and the accelerated test of the tachogenerator is designed by changing and optimizing the load spectrum. The Model of Wiener process based on the performance degradation data is conduceted. As a conlusion, we obtained the life index under normal conditions.

Author Keywords: Electromechanical actuators, accelerated life test, damage cumulative equivalent, life prediction, Wiener process, degradation.

articleTitle: Research on Mobile Internet Location Privacy Protection Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: With the rapid development of the mobile Internet, people's work lifestyle has undergone tremendous changes, and security issues have become increasingly fierce. How to provide users with high-quality services and efficient location privacy protection is the fundamental purpose of the development of smart phone privacy protection technology. This paper studies the location privacy issues that arise when smartphone browsers are located. For the user's geographical location information obtained by the browser positioning, including longitude, latitude, address and time data, a time-based segment access control method based on the role-page model is proposed, and the deficiencies and improvement methods are proposed. Through performance analysis and testing, this method is feasible, and users can effectively control the security and integrity of location data.

Author Keywords: smart phone, positioning, role-page model, access control, time period

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Stepping Stress Stochastic Resonance Fatigue
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: The vibration fatigue is studied from the dynamics, and the resonance fatigue test is designed and completed in this paper. The resonance fatigue test is designed by analyzing the analytic solution of the differential equation of structural vibration response. Taking C/SiC material as the experimental object, the resonance fatigue life of different stress levels should be obtained by stepping from the applied excitation. The equation of the root mean square value and fatigue life of the stress response under resonance fatigue is the conclusion. Compared with the traditional S-N curve, the resonance fatigue failure life of the material is shorter.

Author Keywords: resonance fatigue, dynamic analysis, S-N curve, step stress test, C/SiC material

articleTitle: Data Mining Techniques for the Analysis and Prediction in Bioenergy Yield
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Unconstructed data mining is challenging task in current data mining research domain. Important information than text since it widely used and content very rich information, such as experiment results and parameters setting. This paper examines the large number of tables that existed in the bioenergy field and propose a framework for automatically acquiring data from papers in PDF format and outputs the table information. To evaluate the performance of our automatic data acquiring method, we compare four existing software. 110 tables have been used for evaluation and the final overall score of our method is 90.54 which shows our method has the best performance in terms of position accuracy. This result demonstrates that our approach is promising and scalable. This work also provides a foundation of data processing for bioenergy.

Author Keywords: Table mining, Information extraction, Biochar, Automatic system

articleTitle: Research on Fast Error Calibration Methods for Flexible Measuring Arm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Based on the structure of the joint coordinate measuring machine, the error calibration of the flexible measuring arm is systematically and deeply researched. The straightness error data of the two linear guide rails are obtained by measuring the high-precision square box. Then, the slope of the straightness error curve is obtained by least squares method, and the verticality error can be also calculated. The parallelism error for two rotation axes can be calibrated by test a precision flat. Its result can be quickly compute based on the sampling data. The proposing calibration methods have low cost, easy operation, high efficiency and small environmental restrictions than external calibration by expensive instruments. The experiment has proved the validity and feasibility of the above method.

Author Keywords: flexible measuring arm, error calibration, straightness error, parallelism error, verticality error.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle Charging and Discharging Optimization Management Problem
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In this paper, the normality test of charging behavior and K-means clustering are used to analyze the distribution law, and the linear programming model is established to obtain the optimal ratio of different charging power levels. The cuckoo search algorithm is used to simulate the vehicle queuing charging problem. With the maximum profit of the charging station in the next 24 hours, the cost optimization model is combined with the power system power flow equation to establish a dual-objective optimization model to obtain an optimal charging and discharging scheme.

Author Keywords: electric vehicle interacts with power grid, normal test, cuckoo search algorithm, power flow calculation equation

articleTitle: Dynamic Optimal Radio Resource Management Scheme for V2V
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In this paper, a radio resource allocation scheme supporting V2V is proposed. The proposed scheme can enable the vehicle networking users to dynamically and intelligently utilize the spectrum resources without relying on the information exchange conditions between users, and the spectrum utilization efficiency can reach the theoretical maximum. Firstly, this paper proposes a scenario in which cognitive users and authorized users share spectrum resources friendly: in spectrum sharing, cognitive users find and use spectrum resources that are not used by authorized users, cognitive users can share spectrum resources fairly and efficiently, and cognitive users need to avoid interference to authorized users. Secondly, a dynamic optimal radio resource management scheme is proposed, which can give users the ability to predict, dynamically and intelligently discover and compete spectrum resources, and realize the requirements of the proposed communication scenario of the Internet of vehicles. Finally, for this scheme, V2V simulation scheme based on OFDMA system is designed and the simulation is carried out on MATLAB. The simulation results show that this scheme can effectively improve the channel utilization, achieve good system performance in different scenarios, dynamically and intelligently identify the idle frequency band, and the channel capacity is close to twice of the traditional Nash game scheme.

Author Keywords: V2V, V2X, RRM, self optimization network

articleTitle: CIMR: Intelligent Cellphones Recommendation for Consumers Based on Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Cellphones are electronic devices that people use most in daily life. There are various kinds of cellphones in the market nowadays, while ordinary consumers are dazzled by the huge cellphone market and do not know how to choose a suitable one. Hence, it is of great importance to help them in doing this kind of selection to satisfy their needs. This paper proposes a machine learning based cellphones recommendation approach, CIMR, for consumers to pick up the most suitable cellphones that can mostly meet their desired requirements. We evaluate CIMR by using thousands of real consumers all over the world with two proposed methods: Gradient Boosting Decision Tree (GBDT) and Random Forest (RF). The experimental results show that the accuracy rate for recommending cellphones by using our method is 95.87%, which exceeds the existing old methods by up to 5.49%.

Author Keywords: Machine learning, Cellphone Recommendation, Data Mining

articleTitle: Transient Dynamic Analysis of Gait Motion Based on Two Unilateral External Fixators
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Unilateral external fixators are commonly used to stabilize the fractured tibia bone. Compared to static fixation, axial dynamization has been shown in previous studies to promote callus formation, improve bone healing at fracture sites, and non-axial movements are not conductive to the bone healing and remodeling. In the later stage of fracture correction, patients can bear a certain load and can realize walking and other movements. Gait motion is the active axial dynamic motion. However, it is still unknown how the displacement change at the fracture site during gait movement motion. So the aim of this study is to use transient dynamic finite element method to simulate the actual walking gait process of the human body based on two unilateral fixators. The results reveal that compared Dyna-extor fixator, the Orthofix fixator has a better stability and flexibility during active dynamization motion. This study helps clinicians to plan and execute to training patients, meanwhile facilitates appro priate application of fixators to achieve either active or controlled axial dynamic movement, so that the orthopedist has a better understanding of the biomechanical environment at the fracture site.

Author Keywords: unilateral external fixators, transient dynamic method, gait movement motion, biomecha nical environment

articleTitle: Automatic Extraction and 3D Reconstruction of Bundle Conductor Based on Improved DPC Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: This paper presents a method for automatic extraction and 3D reconstruction of bundle conductor based on improved DPC algorithm. Firstly, the least square method is used to fit the point clouds of bundle conductors with a parabola equation in three-dimensional space, and then the spatial coordinates of each bundle sub-conductor relative to the fitting curve are calculated. Next, an improved DPC algorithm is adopted to cluster the point clouds of the bundle sub-conductors in order to discriminate the number of the bundle sub-conductors and extract the point clouds of each bundle sub-conductor. The method is proved to be more robust than the K-MEANS algorithm. Finally, the least square method is developed to reconstruct the three-dimensional model of the bundle sub-conductors.

Author Keywords: bundle conductor, improved DPC algorithm, clustering algorithm, 3D reconstruction

articleTitle: Method Based on Chinese Characteristic Data
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: The New Car Assessment Program in China (C-NCAP) was launched in 2006 in order to improve car safety performance. C-NCAP management rules are constantly improved and developed based on the status of China's vehicle safety performance and traffic accident situation. The extraction method of Chinese characteristic data and the determination process of evaluation methods is introduced. The results show that active-safety technology will be further strengthened, with test items being more comprehensive and rigorous and different NCAP rating systems being globalized and normalized in the future.

Author Keywords: Vehicle safety, Crash test, C NCAP, Evaluation system

articleTitle: Selecting Unrepeatable Random Starting Nodes in Large-Scale Networks for Parallel Computing and Searching
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: With the prosperity and development of information technology, the scale of extractable networks becomes larger and larger. The current sizes of the networks often turn up to millions, tens of millions, or even hundreds of millions of orders of magnitude. The analysis and mining of large-scale network is bound to cost a lot of time. Therefore, the research of parallel computing and searching on large-scale networks is an urgent task. Parallel computing on large-scale networks often requires the identification of unrepeatable random nodes, but this research is very rare. Aiming at this problem, three algorithms for selecting unrepeatable random starting nodes are proposed based on the existing algorithm. In order to carry on comparison and analysis, firstly designs the corresponding experiment algorithms, and then carries on the experiments, finally carries on the analysis to the experiment results. The results show that two algorithms are more suitable for the selection of unrepeatable random starting nodes in large-scale networks. This paper will be helpful for parallel computing and searching on large-scale networks.

Author Keywords: unrepeatable, random nodes, selecting, large-scale networks

articleTitle: A Lexical Conversion as Preprocessing Method for Text Intention Classification
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: The structure and style of scientific paper can be analyzing by classifying the sentences in scientific paper according to intention. Existing researches on text classification tasks, such as emotion classification, mostly improve the model structure and ignore text preprocessing. In order to get better classification performance in intention classification task, this paper proposes a preprocessing method for lexical conversion of original text statements. First, a set of sentence labels for intention classification of scientific paper is proposed and annotated. Then the words in the sentence are divided into intent-mark words and non-intent-mark words, and the rules are designed to convert the non-intent-mark words. After vectorization, the processed text is input into LSTM network for training and acquisition of classification model. It is shown in several comparative experiments that the classification model obtained by using this method is higher than that obtained by the untreated text model.

Author Keywords: classification of intention, preprocessing, lexical conversion, mark words, convert

articleTitle: Analysis and Evaluation of Settlement Risk in Power Market Based on Triangular Fuzzy Number
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: With the continuous development of China's power market construction, China's power market has gradually entered the pattern of combining long-term power trading with spot market. Aiming at the risk of settlement in power market, a risk assessment is proposed based on triangular fuzzy numbers. The risk assessment method consists identification and rank. The power market settlement risks by risk identification include data risk, credit risk, tax risk and policy risk, and the risk ranking is carried out by using triangular fuzzy numbers to determine the influence degree of the four risks on the settlement of power market. Finally, an example is given to verify that the risk ranking method proposed in this paper. The results show that the method proposed in paper can evaluate effectively the impact degree of the risk during settlement. And, the analysis results can provide the basis for risk effective control.

Author Keywords: power market, settlement risk, triangular fuzzy number, risk ranking

articleTitle: Permutation Invariant Training Based Single-Channel Multi-Talker Speech Recognition with Music Background
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: This paper addresses the single-channel multi-talker speech recognition task with music background, where the speech recognition accuracy will deteriorate significantly. To improve the speech recognition accuracy with music background, we propose two approaches: 1) music-separation method to separate human speech from the music background, 2) permutation invariant training (PIT) for single-channel multi-talker, specifically two-talker, speech separation. Experimental results show that all the proposed methods can improve the speech recognition accuracy. Specifically, we use the music-separation method instead of the de-noising feature-mapping method to extract the human speech. Compared with the de-noising feature-mapping method, the music separation method achieves consistent improvement on the music-distorted speech separation and recognition tasks.

Author Keywords: background music, permutation invariant training, multi-talker speech separation, multi-talker speech recognition

articleTitle: Optimization and Implementation of Sunday Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: String matching algorithm plays an important role in many applications such as data retrieval, network content audit, multi-protocol recognition and so on. An improved algorithm is proposed for string matching based on the discussions of several common string matching algorithms. The algorithm adds suffix comparison before the start of comparing to reduce the times of attempts and increases the average moving step. In this case, it improves the matching efficiency. In the end, the analysis of this algorithm's performance and the comparisons of the testing results of several matching algorithms are given. The experimental results show that Insunday algorithm is the most efficient of several algorithms tested. In the same case, the number of matching times of Insunday algorithm is reduced by 62.67% compared with Sunday algorithm, and it can significantly improve the efficiency of string matching.

Author Keywords: string matching, suffix comparison, head matching, sunday algorithm, insunday algorithm

articleTitle: Detection of Gear Tooth Number and Common Normal Length Change Based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Combining computer technology and camera equipment, teeth of the collected gear images were "discretized" by algorithm and the number of teeth were counted. The radius and modulus of the addendum circle were further obtained to obtain the radius of the base circle. By solving the midpoint where the base circle and tooth profile intersect on the base circle, the equation of the tangent line tangent to the tooth profile was obtained. The length by which the tangent line intersects with the tooth profile across k teeth is the common normal length. It is significant to detect gear tooth number and common normal length using computer vision system instead of manual detection. The shot images were subject to a series of images processing using OpenCV combined with the algorithm, and the length was calculated, which is helpful to achieve non-contact detection of gear precision.

Author Keywords: computer vision, tooth number, change of common normal length, Non-contact measurement, Hough transform

articleTitle: Path Planning of Mobile Robot Based on Neural Process-Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Aiming at the local optimal problem caused by precocious particles in the path planning process of mobile robot by traditional particle swarm optimization algorithm (PSO), a hybrid neural process-pso algorithm was constructed by integrating the idea of motion process prediction into PSO. The main idea is that in the next iteration of particle swarm individuals, the neural process is used to predict the individual location, increasing the diversity of particle swarm at the later stage of the iteration, and avoiding falling into local optimization too early, so as to improve the optimization ability of the algorithm. The improved algorithm is used to solve the robot path planning problem. The experimental results show that the proposed neural process-particle swarm optimization has better path planning ability and better comprehensive performance than the traditional PSO.

Author Keywords: path planning, neural process, particle swarm, predict.

articleTitle: Determination of Suspension Position of Exhaust System of a Passenger Car
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: If the suspension is arranged in the position where the vibration of exhaust system is larger, the vibration transmitted from exhaust system to the body will increase, which will affect the NVH performance of the vehicle. In order to determine the appropriate suspension position of the exhaust system of a passenger car, the finite element model of the exhaust system is established by ANSYS. The suspension point of the exhaust system is arranged by means of ADDOFD. The rationality of the suspension point is verified by static analysis and constrained modal analysis of the exhaust system. The results show that the ADDOFD method is effective in arranging the suspension position of the exhaust system, and the simulation research is of great significance.

Author Keywords: exhaust system, hanging position, average driving freedom displacement, modal analysis

articleTitle: Trinity Interactive Search and Rescue Communication System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: At present, there are various emergency measures for all kinds of sudden dangers in sea, land and air. However, various measures have certain shortcomings and shortcomings in terms of the current development status. Therefore, after a certain thinking and improvement, we need to design a water and air amphibious search and rescue fleet, combine the advantages of both sides, and maximize the efficiency to save the losses in the accident. To control this fleet, we need a reasonable three-in-one communication method.

Author Keywords: search and rescue, efficiency, fleet communication, trinity

articleTitle: Modeling of Resources Management Based on Hierarchical Concept and Nested Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Based on the Nested theory in system science, this paper presents the model and method of complex resources management decision, It is proved that the Nested theory combined with Hierarchical Concept is applicable for the modeling work of decision-making with complex resources management, providing support and assistance for the modeling like water resources management and etc. Nested modeling is the method which support the gradual process of decision-making; it is the nested loop process which consists of problem formulation, test, refining the problem, similarity modeling and global modeling, etc. Nested modeling and decision-making process based on the three phases of intelligence, design and choice by Simon can be well used in resources management system decision-making.

Author Keywords: Decision-Making, Complex Resources Management System, Model

articleTitle: HMAX Model Based on Saliency Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In the classifier of HMAX model, there is a problem that selecting effective information from the image blocks is insufficient during the learning process. Therefore, a HMAX model of saliency detection is proposed to improve the selection of the effective information from the image. The effective information of the dictionary and the effectiveness of target detection are improved by using the method of saliency detection in the dictionary learning process of HMAX model. Finally, the detected targets were classified and experimentally verified. The experimental results shown that the Hierarchical Model and X(HMAX) model of improved has higher detection efficiency and the classification accuracy compared with the traditional HMAX model.

Author Keywords: biological vision, HMAX model, saliency detection, image classification

articleTitle: An Information Granularity Adjustment Algorithm Based on Bidirectional S-Rough Set
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: A novel attack intention granularity extracting method based on bidirectional S-rough sets was proposed to fulfill the different requirements for different attack intention granularity in different stages of engagement in dynamic belligerent environment. The model of attack intention based on bidirectional S-rough sets was established, the construction of attack intention based on dynamic attribute was given, and the grain growth algorithm based on the lower approximate intention information particle and the grain degradation algorithm based on the upper approximate intention information particle were proposed. The granularity of attack intention information can be adjusted dynamically with the demand of engagement.

Author Keywords: bidirectional S-rough set, information granularity, attack intention

articleTitle: Study of a Community Partitioning Algorithm Based on Modularity Measurement
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: The current method of community division has the characteristics of single division method and inaccurate division result. Aiming at this problem, this algorithm proposes a community partitioning algorithm based on modularity measurement, which solves the problem of accuracy of community partitioning results. Firstly, the algorithm analyses the attributes of social networks, defines the structure of social network nodes, and describes two problems of node overlap structure and node hierarchy. Secondly, iteratively calculates the influence of two structures in social networks, split the nodes that are mixed together. Thirdly, measure the similarity and community module as two evaluation indicators, and divide the social network into different communities. Finally, using the three real data sets of Karate Club Network, Dolphin Social Network and The Pol Books Dataset, this algorithm is designed to compare with other algorithms. The experimental results show that the algorithm modularity of the algorithm has higher accuracy of community division.

Index Terms: Number Of Nodes In The Network
Author Keywords: community division, modularity measurement

articleTitle: Image Denoising Using Eigenvectors of Graph Laplacian with Low-Rank Approximation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Recently, a method based on eigenvectors of graph Laplacian (EGL) is proposed for image denoising. However, the EGL employs a complex measure based on the Euclidean distance to describe the similarity between patch pair, which has limitation to some degree in high-level noise. In this paper, we proposed an image denoising algorithm using eigenvectors of graph Laplacian with distance estimation via low-rank approximation (LR-EGL) to make up for this defect. In detail, with probability distribution of distance as prior knowledge, low-rank approximation is employed to estimate the distance between similar patches in underlying clean image. Then, the estimated distance is fused into EGL algorithm to construct graph Laplacian matrix and generate reliable eigenvectors to denoising. Experiments demonstrate that our algorithm outperforms EGL and is comparable with well-developed methods, especially with high-level noise.

Author Keywords: image denoising, distance estimation, low-rank approximation, graph Laplacian

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Surface Micro Textures of Tool on Chip Deformation Based on FEA
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In order to reveal the influence of micro textures of tool surface on chip deformation, and improve the chip morphology of hardened steel GCr15 cut by PCBN tools, and enhance the degree of chip bending deformation, so as to facilitate chip breaking and chip removal. Designing micro-hole textures with different sizes, using Finite Element Analysis (FEA) method, the cutting simulation of dry turning hardened steel GCr15 with micro-hole tools was carried out. By comparing with chips produced by non-textured tools in cutting process, the effect and mechanism of micro-hole textures on chip deformation of tool rake face were studied, and different cutting speeds were designed to analyze the effect of cutting speed on chip deformation. The finite element simulation results showed that compared with the chip bending deformation formed by non-textured tools, the micro-hole tools with different diameters had different effects on the chip bending deformation degree. The effect of smaller diameter micro-hole textures on chip bending deformation was more significant, and the effect of larger diameter micro-hole textures on chip bending deformation degree was affected by cutting speed. In addition, the cutting speed had a great influence on the degree of chip bending deformation formed by non-textured tools and micro-textured tools. The micro-hole textures treatment on the rake face of tool changed the shearing effect among tool, the workpiece and chip in the cutting process, which had a great influence on the chip deformation degree in the cutting process.

Author Keywords: Micro-hole textures, Chip morphology, Cutting speed, Shear Stress

articleTitle: A Resource Allocation Scheme Based on Least Squares Support Vector Machine and Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In this paper, a classification evaluation model is designed by least squares support vector machine (LS-SVM). And then, the particle swarm optimization algorithm (PSO) is used to construct the resource allocation scheme. Finally, we solve a reasonable resource development problem according to the existing school evaluation standards. This paper takes the schools in Xi'an as an example to expound the present situation of basic resource allocation in schools.

Author Keywords: data analysis, SVM, particle swarm optimization algorithm

articleTitle: Context-Based Synthetic Data for Logo Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of sparse training samples in logo recognition task, a multi-type context-based logo data synthesis algorithm is proposed. The algorithm comprehensively utilizes the local and full context of the logo object and the scene image to guide the synthesis of the logo image. The experimental results on the FlickrLogos-32 show that the proposed algorithm can greatly improve the performance of the logo recognition algorithm without relying on additional manual annotation, verify the validity of the synthesis algorithm, and further prove that multi-type context can improve the performance of the object recognition algorithm.

Author Keywords: Logo recognition, context, data synthesis, deep learning

articleTitle: Flat Folding Table Design Based on Multi-Objective Optimization Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In this paper, the design model and dynamic process of a foldable creative flat folding table are studied. By transforming the problem into a plan view, the coordinates of the edge of the table are written by the geometric relationship, and the multi-objective optimization model is established to determine the optimal folding angle of the folding table, designing processing parameters such as steel bar position and slot length, using Matlab software to draw a dynamic change diagram, so that the production of folding tables to meet customer needs. After analysis and testing, it is believed that the above model design established in this paper can be extended to real life, and can be close to the shape desired by the customer to the greatest extent, and has strong practicability.

Author Keywords: folding table, multi-objective optimization model, dynamic change, geometric relationship

articleTitle: A Method of Decision Rule Induction Based on DEMATEL and Dominance-Based Rough Set
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: According to the situation of experience-based procurement decision-making, it proposes a method of decision rule induction based on decision making and trial evaluation laboratory (DEMATEL) and dominance-based rough set approach, which comprehensively utilizes the data mining capabilities by rough set and the analytical ability to find intrinsic influence relationship among multiple factors in complex systems by DEMATEL to better solve the problem of rules credibility decline, causing by the logical relationship between condition attributes, and makes the decision rules more in line with reality. The method is proved effective by an example.

Author Keywords: dominance based rough set, decision making and trial evaluation laboratory (DEMATEL), procurement decision-making, decision rule

articleTitle: A Predicting Initial Layout of Components Method Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In the structural topology optimization approaches, the Moving Morphable Components (MMC) is a new method to obtain the optimized structural topologies by optimizing shapes, sizes, and locations of components. However, the initial layout of components has a strong influence on the rate of convergence. In this paper, a predicting the initial layout of components method using machine learning is developed. In this method, the training set is generated under the MMC framework and supported vector regression (SVR) is employed to establish the mapping between the design parameters characterizing the initial layout and the number of iterations. How to combine machine learning (ML) with the MMC to predict the tilt angle initial layout of components that satisfy a given number of iterations is discussed. Finally, the cantilever beam example is sued to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

Author Keywords: topology optimization, Moving Morphable Components, machine learning, convergence rate, initial layout

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Female Diabetic Patients Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Since diabetes is prone to serious complications, the construction of a mathematical model of diabetes plays an important role in the diagnosis and prevention of diabetes. In this paper, 769 female cases of diabetes were found, including the number of pregnancies, glucose, insulin, body mass index, genetic function of diabetes, age and so on. They were separated into training set and test set by the ratio of 8:2. Logistic regression (LR) and support vector machine (SVM) were used to classify and identify female diabetic patients. The results showed that the RBF SVM method is superior to LR in terms of accuracy, and F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> score. But the Ridge regression is better in the evaluation of recall. Then the fusion model combined of Ridge method and RBF SVM method could improve the result in the evaluation of diagnosis of female diabetes. The accuracy, recall and F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> score showed the fusion model is more suitable for the identification and diagnosis of female diabetic patients. The research in this paper helps doctors diagnose diabetes quickly and has guiding significance for clinical treatment-related chronic diseases.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator
Author Keywords: diabetes diagnosis, Logistic regression, support vector machine, model fusion

articleTitle: A Dynamic Real-Time Three-Dimensional Attitude Reconstruction Method Based on Multi-Core Optical Fiber Subtitle as Needed
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of three-dimensional (3D) pose and shape detection, a 3D shape detection method based on multi-core fiber distortion compensation was designed. This method is a 3D shape detection method based on three-core fiber grating array, which adopts interpolation, cyclic iteration and distortion compensation method. The simulation results show that this method can achieve high precision 3D shape detection.

Author Keywords: 3D reconstruction, multi-core fiber, shape sensing, torsion compensation

articleTitle: Optimization of Intercity Train Operation Plan Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Passenger flow and the growth period of passenger flow of the intercity railway will change with time, so it is necessary to evaluate and optimize the existing operation plan based on the actual passenger flow on a regular or irregular basis. The thesis proposes the definition and calculation method of passenger flow deviation coefficient, which is used to evaluate the matching degree between the operation plan and the actual passenger flow. On this basis, the thesis established an optimization model for intercity railway operation plan by minimizing passenger travel time and minimizing enterprise operating costs, and designs a specific genetic algorithm to solve the model. Finally, an example of an intercity railway line is used to verify the effectiveness of the model and algorithm. The research results of the thesis can provide a basis for the periodic evaluation and optimization of the development plan of the intercity railway in the growth period of passenger flow in China.

Author Keywords: intercity railway, passenger flow deviation coefficient, optimization of operation plan, multi-objective programming model, genetic algorithm

articleTitle: Describing Approach for Model-Driven Collaborative Application Development
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In order to resolve the problems of model-driven collaborative application development, a new formal description framework was proposed for the description of software architecture model, in which category theory, algebraic specifications and process algebra were combined together. Software components and the relationship between them were described respectively by category objects and morphisms. The different types of morphisms depicted the semantics contained by component relationships. Thus typed category diagram fully represented software architecture model, as well as functors of category theory described the mapping relationships between architecture models. The formal framework was available to determine whether a transformation to meet certain characteristics or constraints, and a collaborative authoring system was used as an example to illustrate the application of this method. The application research shows that, the approach enhances semantic description capabilities of architecture model, and can be used as an effective supplement for existing software modeling method.

Author Keywords: computer software, model-driven software development, software architecture, collaborative applications, formal description

articleTitle: Research on Artificial Intelligence Visualization Application under Internet of Things Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Machine learning is an inevitable outcome of the development of artificial intelligence research to a certain stage. It has become the most popular technology in the fields of computer vision and natural language processing. Learning techniques such as inductive logic programming, neural network-based connectionist learning technology, and statistical learning theory are constantly evolving. The shortcomings of various learning techniques in data representation and result processing have become a concern of many scholars. As one of the cutting-edge science and technology in the 21st century, artificial intelligence has a profound impact on education. This research is based on the artificial intelligence in Visualization Application for nearly 12 years. It has carried out visual analysis of research hotspots and frontiers. In addition, this study also discusses the research content through cluster analysis, discusses the influence of artificial intelligence on Chinese education field, and reflects on it.

Author Keywords: Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Neural Network, Visualization Application

articleTitle: The Optimization of Uniform Concentric Ring Array Using Improved Simulated Annealing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In this paper, a novel modified objective function is proposed, which represents a novel approach for optimization problems of uniform concentric ring arrays (UCA). Improved simulated annealing algorithm (SA) has been applied to the proposed method. The results obtained by the novel modified objective function are compared with those obtained by the objective function proposed by Cornwell. Numerical comparison results have been carried out to demonstrate the validity and outperformance of this new proposed approach.

Author Keywords: modified objective function, uniform concentric ring arrays (URA), optimization, simulated annealing algorithm (SA)

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Rapid Detection Platform for Fault of Communication Gateway
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: As the communication hub of a certain type of command system, the communication gateway is the key equipment to ensure the information transmission of the whole system. It is found that the communication gateway is one of the single devices with the highest failure rate in the system during operation, and the rapid detection and location failure becomes the maintenance guarantee difficulty. Based on the system composition, this paper comprehensively uses ARM and SQL database technology to design and implement the communication gateway detection platform from both hardware and software. The results show that the communication gateway detection platform realizes the function of fault diagnosis and location of the communication gateway circuit board, and the operation is simple and time-sensitive.

Author Keywords: communication gateway, detection platform, ARM, SQL

articleTitle: An Assembly Sequence Planning Method Based on Discrete Difference Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: The assembly sequence of products directly affects the assembly quality and assembly cost of products. Artificial planning assembly sequence can no longer meet the increasingly complex requirements of assembly. More and more intelligent algorithms are applied to the field of sequence planning. In order to improve product assembly efficiency, the paper proposes an assembly sequence planning method based on the discrete difference genetic algorithm. Differential evolution algorithm is a heuristic search algorithm that can be programmed with real numbers and has a simple structure and is easy to implement. According to the characteristics of assembly sequence planning, the operations of variation, crossover and mutation were redefined, and the fitness function model with the feasibility, stability, assembly direction change times and assembly tool change times as the evaluation index was established. The algorithm is analyzed by the vise assembly example. The feasibility and stability of the algorithm are verified. The comparison with genetic algorithm proves: the method is more efficient; the convergence speed is faster; the quality and quantity dependence of the initial population is smaller.

Author Keywords: Assembly Sequence Plannin, Discrete Differential Evolution, Genetic Algorithm, Virtual Assembly

articleTitle: Static and Fatigue Strength Analysis of a Hyperbaric Oxygen Cabin
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: The hyperbaric oxygen cabin plays an important role in the medical industry. In this paper, static and fatigue strength analysis of a hyperbaric oxygen cabin was carried by performing finite element analysis with the ANSYS software and the strength of the equipment was assessed. It is found that the strength of the equipment met the strength requirements according to JB4732. The calculated allowable number of cycles was greater than the design fatigue cycles, implying the fatigue strength of the equipment met the use requirements.

Author Keywords: hyperbaric oxygen cabin, finite element analysis, strength assessment, fatigue analysis

articleTitle: Inter-Pole Short Circuit Protection Strategy for Flexible DC Distribution Network Converter Valve and Differential Combination
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Inter-electrode short-circuit fault in flexible DC distribution network is a very serious fault, because the current amplitude is extremely high and the spread speed is fast. Therefore, reliable identification and accurate positioning are urgent problems to be solved. This paper proposes a strategy combining the delay blocking of the converter valve and the fast line differential protection. Configure data processing and fast line differential protection with fast calculation speed, set the protection configuration and signal measurement point inside the half-bridge modular multi-level converter (HB-MMC), and combine the protection point signals set by the DC line, bus and AC bus of the distribution network to perform the inter-pole fault protection configuration. The simulation topology model of flexible DC power distribution system is built on the PSCAD platform, and the fault characteristics of typical faults on the DC line are simulated and analyzed to verify the correctness of the protection configuration and fault location strategy. In the simulation, when the DC line inter-pole short circuit occurs, while the line voltage and current meet the operating conditions of the DC low-voltage over-current protection, the protection starts quickly, the delay locks the converter valve, and the line current begins to decrease, at this time the line differential protection can complete the fault location in this process, and the DC breaker completes the trip. The results show that the method can accurately realize the fast limitation and accurate positioning of the line faults, and ensure the safe and reliable operation of the flexible DC power distribution system.

Author Keywords: Flexible DC distribution network, Converter valve, fast line differential, PSCAD simulation, Fault location

articleTitle: Research on 3D Variable Design of Corrugated Box Based on SolidWorks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Using the VBA (Visual Basic for Applications) component of SolidWorks, the three-dimensional variable design of the corrugated box is realized, and the three-dimensional variable design of the structure and size of the corrugated box is realized, and the development map of the corrugated box can be drawn. The box type of the software is drawn according to the FEFCO (The European Federation of Corrugated Board Manufactures) standard. It has a standard corrugated box type library, and can also design and draw the structure of the carton according to customer requirements. During the development process, by modifying the menu file of the SolidWorks system, the variable design can be directly accessed from the menu, and has better human-computer interaction ability. The development of this software has certain practical significance for the design and manufacture of existing corrugated boxes.

Author Keywords: solidworks, corrugated box, interactive interface, secondary development

articleTitle: Non-Minimum Essential Matrix Estimation Using Sum of Square Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Among 2D computer vision problems, relative pose estimation using two calibrated cameras is one of the most important. Because the cameras cannot be perfectly calibrated, noise will occur and several methods were introduced to reduce the noise and accurately estimate the Essential matrix which includes information about the rotation and translation of relative poses. Zhao and Briales both proposed their own methods for this problem. This paper utilizes a method called Sum of Square (SOS) to optimize Zhao's and Briales' methods. SOS successfully increases the accuracy of Zhao's method, and reduce the complexity of Briales' method by eliminating the need of hundreds of redundant constraints. Moreover, a local minimum solver fmincon in MATLAB is also introduced to acquire more accurate result.

Author Keywords: Computer vision, 2D relative pose estimation, Essential matrix estimation, Sum of squares (SOS).

articleTitle: Network Capacity Reliability Evaluation Based on Monte Carlo Simulation and Line Sampling Methods
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel composite network reliability evaluating approach using a line sampling method. The essential concept of this method is to replace the random points with lines to explore the failure regions of high-dimensional systems of the sampling process to increase the occurrence frequency of the rare events, thereby improving the assessment efficiency of sampling rare failure events. In the traditional Monte Carlo simulation approach, the power system samples are randomly selected from the sampling space. The sampling space are further reshaped by a normal distribution in the line sampling method to enable an adaptive design of line sampling space. An important sampling direction is introduced to generate sampling states on given direction. The IEEE-RTS 79, modified IEEE-RTS-79, and IEEE-RTS-96 test systems are used to analyse the computational performance of the proposed approach. The results indicate that the proposed method can improve the efficiency of the power system reliability evaluation, especially in the case of high-reliable power systems.

Author Keywords: line sampling, important direction, reliability assessment, network

articleTitle: A Novel Method to Improve Hit Rate for Big Data Quick Reading
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In big data mining analysis, the data records in the dataset are randomly retrieved. The distributed storage modes, such as BigTable, HBase, provide the cache policy for file blocks in retrieval operations. Since these records are scattered in different file blocks, the block cache does not have a high hit rate. To deal with the above problem, we propose an LRU-based double queue K-frequency cache method (DLK). The method presents a double queue storage structure, applying different storage and eviction rules for the data with varying access frequency (i.e., high/low access frequency). While the method divides the memory into data area and list area and adopts different data structure to reduce the time of data retrieval and data processing. The experimental results show that proposed method can reduce retrieval time by 30% with the cache mechanism. Compared with existing methods DLK can improve the hit rate by 60.1% and reduce the retrieval time by 43.5%. While applying in smaller cache capacity, our method outperforms other algorithms.

Author Keywords: Distributed cache, replacement, frequency, double-queue

articleTitle: Air Combat Intelligent Assistant Decision-Making Sample Data Cultivation Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Air combat combines with high technology and high intelligence. When face to the ever-changing air situation, it is especially important for computers to assist air combat commanders to make correct decisions quickly. This paper expounds the main content of air-assisted intelligent assistant decision-making, analyzes the characteristics and elements of auxiliary decision-making sample data, describes the multi-machine air combat situation structurally, and proposes a method of air combat-assisted decision-making sample data based on experimental design ideas. It produces the basis of sample data with good uniformity, filling and coverage, so that machine learning capable of intelligent decision-making provides representative sample data, and provides data foundation for researching intelligent air combat, intelligent target, and virtual opponent and so on.

Author Keywords: air combat, intelligent assistant decision, experimental design, data cultivation

articleTitle: Design of Generalized Predictive Controller for T-Type Network Inverter
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: T-type network inverter is a topology that can realize three-phase output from two single-phase output inverters through transformer. The purpose of this paper is to design the circuit topology and controller to make the inverter output voltage meet. Aviation power requirements. Firstly, the DC power input circuit and transformer structure are designed according to the principle of voltage vector synthesis. Then the controller is designed by state space average modeling method and generalized predictive control method. Finally, the system model is built by MATLAB/Simulink simulation software. The 115V/400Hz three-phase power required to convert 27V DC power to aviation power is realized, which verifies the effectiveness of the design content of this paper.

Author Keywords: T-type inverter, voltage vector synthesis, state space average modeling, generalized predictive control

articleTitle: Sun Shadow Localization Problem Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the change of the sun's shadow and the positioning problem. Through the knowledge of natural geography, the relationship between the shadow length and various parameters is solved, and the planning model is established. According to the given data, the location and date of the straight bar under the sun illumination are determined. Based on the least squares idea, the relationship between the shadow length and the time is fitted, and the longitude of the straight rod is solved according to the shortest time of Beijing. A multi-parameter single-objective optimization model is established. The error between the measured value of the solar elevation angle and the actual value is used as the objective function to determine the constraint conditions of the parameter latitude and the length of the rod. Firstly, the grid search method is used to solve the problem. In order to improve the calculation speed and introduce the genetic algorithm, the results are very close.

Author Keywords: goal programming, least squares method, grid search method, genetic algorithm, edge detection, bilinear map correction

articleTitle: Research and Application of the Intelligent Biogas Monitoring System Based on LoRa Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In the towns, there are problems such as poor real-time meter reading and biogas management, and this paper constructs an intelligent biogas monitoring system based on LoRa (Long Range) technology to meet biogas science monitoring and management. First, the architecture design is carried out, and the system is divided into a physical acquisition layer, a network link layer, and a management application layer. Then, it is developed for repeaters, gateways, and wireless networks commonly used in LoRa systems to realize biogas data relay, receive commands, and real-time upload. Then, the system adopts a modular design, develops the software protocol for the application layer, and partitions the network nodes in the area. Finally, the electrical drawing design, the power distribution cabinet design, the control port layout of the gas supply process monitoring and control system are carried out, and the application is formed at the demonstration point. Through application, the biogas monitoring system has the advantages of long communication distance, low power consumption, and accurate and timely data collection, and can be applied and promoted.

Author Keywords: LoRa technology, intelligent monitoring, biogas, the aggregation gateway

articleTitle: A Detector for Stacking Objects Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: This paper aims to design a detector based on a neural network to detect workpieces in a multi-stacking situation. Because our samples have similarity with each other which will make our model overfitting without any data enhancement method. We propose a novel way to enhance our data, which is that adding "stack" conditions to our single sample and use transfer-learning at the stage of training which is a normal way to solve the problem of training network with the tiny dataset. Our sampling method partly eliminates the correlation between samples to some extent and the model trained on our dataset performs well. As a result, we get the accuracy of classification with 96.04% and the mAP of object-detection with 91.12% and 92.61%. This paper gives a new sampling method to solve the problem of detecting multi-stacking objects. For details, this paper will introduce from the method for training data sampling to the performance of object-detection.

Author Keywords: neural network, sampling method, transfer-learning

articleTitle: A Novel Shock Isolator Designed Based on Energy Trapping
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: A brief introduction is given for shock resistance materials based on traditional materials and novel mechanical metamaterials in the paper. Then mechanism and shock response of shock resistance metamaterial based on elastic strain energy trapping mechanism is carried out in terms of theory, design, simulation and experiments. Cell microstructure with high trapping energy and low recovering force is discussed for designing and quantitative design method is established for shock resistance metamaterials. Samples are prepared for shock resistance experiments which shows great improvements for shocking absorbing.

Author Keywords: shock isolator, energy trapping, self-locking mechanical metamaterials

articleTitle: Detection of Research Front Topic Based on Data of NSF Artificial Intelligence Project
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Artificial intelligence in the United States has been the world's leading, and the detection of research front topic based on the data of NSF artificial intelligent projects is helpful for us to obtain quantitative information for prioritized technologies that could be used for technology management and decision making for research funding and technology investment in the field of artificial intelligent. PLDA model was used to identify topic contained in the NSF project data in the field of artificial intelligence from 2013 to 2018. The funding time, funding amount and centrality indexes of the topic were taken as three indexes to judge research front topics. Threshold value was set according to Pareto Law. And 17 research front topics in the artificial intelligence field were determined. The results showed that 13 aspects, including intelligent system and intelligent community, quantum technology, molecular programming, intelligent simulation, underwater communication and positioning, big data analysis and so on, are the main research front contents concerned in the field of artificial intelligence in the United State.

Author Keywords: National Science Foundation, Fund project, PLDA, Artificial intelligence, Research front

articleTitle: Research on the Most Throwing Position of UAV Based on Mathematical Modeling
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In order to help Puerto Rico, our team design a mathematical model used to develop an efficient scheme. After analyzing the information, an evaluation mechanism is established, then analysis is carried out based on a mathematical programming approach. For the design of the "Dronego" system, an Fuzzy AHP-based evaluation model is used to score the performance of each drone under three criteria of the maximum load, the cost and the capacity of the drone. The fuzzy weights during calculation have a great impact on the model. To reduce this effect, the PSO algorithm is used to correct the weight matrix. The PSO algorithm searches for the corresponding weight based on the existing information and modifies the weight matrix, then replaces it with the model for calculation. Consider the location of the ISO container by searching a large amount of data, and summarize four attributes: population, distance from the East Coast, number of medical items required, and number of surrounding roads. Through standardizing those four attributes, the dimension is removed, and the merits and demerits of the site are evaluated. The first three are selected as locations. Next, a mathematical programming model is established by analyzing the ISO container location, taking into account the system's fastest response and merchant cost issues. The objective function should be such that the number of drones in the system and the waiting time of the drug delivery point are as small as possible. Considering the objective function under various constraints such as meeting the needs of the hospital and the estimation of previous evaluation model for the Drone, a specific DroneGo disaster response system can be obtained: Drone—H (3), B(3), G(1), and F(1). Finally, the drone fleet has been designed and the payload packaging configuration has been obtained for each drone by the loading capacity of the specific drone and the requirements of the corresponding location. Then, by simulating the flight capacity of the drone and the needs of the transportation destination, the weight of the maximum no-load distance of the drone are measured, and finally the transmission route and timetable are obtained.

Author Keywords: Analytic Hierarchy Process, Mathematical Model, Most Throwing Position of UAV, PSO Algorithm

articleTitle: Sound Event Recognition Based in Feature Combination with Low SNR
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In the sound environment of instability noise, the recognition rate of sound events would be reduced if using a single sound feature to train public sound data. To solve this problem, we propose a new method of sound event recognition based in feature combination with low SNR in this paper. It improves the recognition of sound events in real scenes by adding noise to public sound data sets. On the other hand, in order to overcome the inaccuracy of single features in noise recognition and significantly improved the recognition rate, we propose a new combination method which combining multiple features and drawing on the advantages of image recognition. Actual test shows that the public sound data set with noise has good generalization ability to the actual scene. The designed combined features can further improve the classification recognition performance, and the recognition rate of real environmental acoustic events can reach 75%, meeting the requirements of the actual system.

Author Keywords: sound recognition, ambient acoustic event, combined feature, Convolutional neural network

articleTitle: Online Intelligent Monitoring System for Operation States of Dedust Facilities in a Steel Plant
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: In order to ensure the stable operations of dust cleaning facilities in accordance with design requirements, reduce fugitive emissions and prevent illegal discharges in an iron and steel industry, the embedded signal sampling and monitoring technology, signal acquisition, data transmission, data correction, data security and system functions were developed, and the general online monitoring system for operation states and emissions of dust cleaning facilities were constructed, which were based on the existing continuous dust emission monitoring system in the iron and steel industry. It provided a more efficient and reliable monitoring platform for the environmental supervision of government departments and the operation management of the dust cleaning facilities in the iron and steel industry.

Author Keywords: online intelligent monitoring, dedust system, operation state, emission, operation management

articleTitle: Modeling and Dynamic Characteristic Analysis of Space Robotic Cables (Flexible Bodies)
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM)
abstract: Space robotic cables are responsible for the transmission of load data and power at the end of robots. They are mounted on the space robot bodies and will move along with the robot bodies. In the extreme environment of coupling of high and low temperatures, radiation and microgravity in space, the cables covered by shielding layers will become extremely heavy and hard, while the joints of space robots under strict resource constraints are relatively weak. In the course of motion, heavy cables will cause strong non-linear interference to weak joints of space robots, leading to slow rotation or oscillation of joints at specific locations.
